R. to IV, 4</cite> (play on <he>ת̇ל̇פ̇י̇ו̇ת̇</he>, <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 4:4:8">ib.</cite>) <he>אני הוא שעשיתיו ת̇ל̇ … י׳ וכ׳</he> I made it (the Temple) a ruin in this world, and I shall make it a beauty in the future (some ed. <he>יָפְיָפִית</he>).
